description.la: Miscellaneorum libri quinque: elucidationes variae in Scripturam, sententiae et quaestiones (partim Hugonis).
description.en-US: The five books of the Miscellanea printed in PL 177 under Hugh’s name: biblical elucidations, sentences and questions, collected by the Victorine school and only partly Hugh’s own. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 177, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: Os cinco livros da Miscelânea impressos por Migne sob o nome de Hugo: elucidações bíblicas, sentenças e questões reunidas pela escola de São Vítor, apenas em parte de Hugo.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 177 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text AuInHuD.Miscel2, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
